evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies block template tracking in src/node/block_template_manager.cpp, src/interfaces/mining.h, and src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp.
rationale: Adds memory load tracking to the Mining IPC interface to address memory retention from evicted mempool transactions pinned by external templates. This improves the completeness and operational stability of the mining interface for external consumers like Stratum v2 template providers (issue #33899, stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63).
